The Flashiest Camper Around Is Now Even Better: See the 2027 Keystone Reign 15RB
24 photos
Photo: Keystone RV
Who doesn't like their adventure trailer with a bit more oomph? That was not the reasoning behind the creation of the Reign series of adventure trailers over at Keystone RV just a couple of years ago, but it could have been. For 2027, the Reign 15RB is still that, but also better.
When Keystone debuted the Reign trailers , they promised they (the trailers) would solve some of the industry's biggest and most enduring problems linked to wood-reliant construction. The Reign towables would be adventure trailers, not travel trailers, that would guarantee a lifetime of enjoyment in a form factor that was still compact, lightweight, and – you guessed it – eye-catching.
They kept that promise, while also offering what was dubbed the flashiest camper around. They also did not settle for this initial win, continuing to work on the floorplans based on customer feedback. The 2027 Reign series includes five floorplans, with the 15RB coming as the second smallest of the bunch.
It's being redesigned for 2027, and the upgraded interior puts the focus back on this being a premium towable while adding extra functionality and one more sleeping berth. Seeing how this is still a compact trailer, these are no small achievements, you will agree.
Photo: Keystone RV From the outside, the Reign 15RB is the same as in previous years. That means you get a single-axle towable on a BAL huck-bolted chassis with a body of automotive aluminum painted a very special Mercedes blue that is exclusive to Keystone. Keystone calls the construction Hyper Construction, including HyperCore composite body, aluminum skin, and HyperDeck fully composite flooring.
Also unchanged are frameless tinted windows, a fully enclosed underbelly, composite entry steps, and the Edgeview exterior glow lighting system on a dimmer, which is the one that earned the trailer the moniker of being the flashiest and loudest at any campsite. The axle is a Dexter Torflex, so you get independent suspension, as well as 15-inch all-terrain tires with aluminum rims.
The original layout was a three-person one, with a front Murphy-style bed and a small booth dinette that dropped into a single bed, a galley kitchen, and a full rear bath that also gave the camper its name ("RB"). The 2027 model year brings a similar layout, but with upgrades that add extra value.
Photo: YouTube/Myles RVs The first thing that stands out is the addition of a flip-up bunk bed over the dinette, which takes the camper from a three-person to a four-person one and makes it even more appealing for families with kids. It could be that this bunk will only be available as an option, but still. It wasn't there last year.
Then, the entire cabinetry has been redesigned and now includes opening doors where you only found elastic netting before. This was a choice meant to save weight and reduce costs, but Myles from Myles RVs , who toured a 2027 unit for the first video at the bottom of the page, says that cabinetry is made of composite so that it feels sturdy, wood-like, but also light.
Keystone is also adding more storage options, particularly around the Murphy-style bed in the bedroom, which now offers overhead cubbies, matching wardrobes, and a pair of large drawers underneath. Another instance where storage is greatly improved is in the bathroom, which gets a full wall of cabinets and drawers for all your essentials – and maybe some extras as well.
Photo: YouTube/Myles RVs The most obvious result of this redesign is that the camper now looks cozier and more elegant. It's as expressive on the inside as it's on the outside, and the best part is that this redesign comes with exactly zero extra lbs to the dry weight. Keystone mentions 3,348 lbs (1,518 kg) before options, but the unit below has some, so that figure is a bit higher.
The Reign 15RB is a no-slide trailer measuring just 19 feet 11 inches (6 meters) in total length, yet just as nice as a couple's coach or as a family-friendly one. It's compact but it comes equipped with just about every feature you could need for a comfortable vacation.
The kitchen, for example, is appointed with a two-burner gas cooktop under a glass cover, an oversize stainless steel sink under a cover with another Keystone exclusive, the pull-out sprayer faucet, a convection microwave with airfryer function, solid surface counters, and the largest fridge and freezer unit of this class. That's no exaggeration: Keystone was already offering a large fridge in this floorplan in 2026, but it's even bigger now.
Photo: YouTube/Myles RVs The dinette offers space to dine and chill, storage, and even a smart TV on a swivel on the far wall. Needless to say, with the flip-up bunk, you have limited access to the window on the off-side, but Keystone deserves extra points for making the underside of that bunk as aesthetically pleasing as possible. Functionality is important, but let's not undermine the importance of aesthetics.
The bathroom is a full-width one with a step-up shower with a squeegee door, a small sink on a vanity, a plastic foot-flush toilet, and that oversize storage unit on the off-side wall. It's spacious enough even if you plan on maximum occupancy.
Standard features also include a 13,500-BTU non-ducted AC unit, a 20,000-BTU furnace, a 42,000-BTU Suburban tankless on-demand water heater, 220W of solar on the roof, and heated holding tanks with 37, 27, and 27-gallon (140, 102, and 102-liter) capacities for fresh, gray, and black water, respectively.
Photo: YouTube/Myles RVs Sale prices for the 2027 Reign 15RB will depend on dealership discounts and extras , ranging between $28,000 and $33,000. As always, looking is free of charge, and the two videos below offer the best side-by-side comparison in terms of upgrades, added functionality, and style.
